sourceTextExcerpts.text: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

wikipediaRead.locator: “Elhanan and Goliath” section, lines 243–247; opening lines 186–190
wikipediaRead.identityBasisJa: The article directly discusses 2 Samuel 21:19 and compares its Goliath wording with 1 Chronicles 20:5. It states the Hebrew text does not include “brother,” while fixed WEB does. It does not establish which reading should govern this WEB-scoped profile.

occurrenceAudit.reasonJa: 固定WEBは「ギト人ゴリアトの兄弟」を殺したと記す。ゴリアト本人の行為・死ではなく、兄弟関係の相手として名が直接現れる。
